Summary: Standard loan file lifecycle (10 stages, configurable)
Description:
Replace the 3 old statuses with the standard flow: Application Submitted → System Login → Bureau Passed → PD Cleared → In Credit Query → Pending Documents → Operations Query → Submitted to Ops for Disbursement → OTC/PDD → Fund Transferred (Rejected stays outside the flow).

Acceptance criteria:
- Stages, labels and owner (Credit / Operations / DSA-BO) come from one config file, so the flow can be changed without code changes
- Loan Files screen: swipeable stage pipeline (tap to filter), tabs All / In progress / Disbursed / Rejected
- Opening a file shows the full lifecycle: done stages with dates, current stage with "now with <owner>", upcoming stages greyed, next step
- All status badges, plans, reports and meeting prep use the new stages

Summary: Show loan file stage on customer profile
Description:
Every customer shows where their loan file currently stands.

Acceptance criteria:
- Customer card (Clients > Customers) shows a stage badge
- Customer profile has a 'Loan file stage' card: stage name, 'Stage X of 10', 10-segment progress bar, who holds it now and the next step; 'See all stages' expands the full list
- PD-queue customers sit at Bureau Passed and move to PD Cleared automatically once the Sarthi PD report exists; leads show their file stage; new enquiries show 'Not applied yet'

Summary: Connector as a separate channel from DSA
Description:
Connectors (shopkeepers, CAs, agents who refer customers) get their own channel, with the same capabilities as a DSA.

Acceptance criteria:
- Clients tab has a DSA | Connector | Customers switch; search, filters, counts and compare work per channel
- Adding from the Connector tab creates a connector
- Connector profile = same as DSA (visits, files, meetings, Sarthi AI, scheduling) with a 'Connector · <profession>' badge
- Plan your day has a separate Connectors section and a Connectors filter chip; matched connectors carry a Connector tag
- Visit logger and meeting recorder pickers list connectors

Summary: Firm name optional for DSA / connector
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Add DSA form: 'Firm name (optional)', no longer blocks saving; review shows 'Independent · no firm' when blank
- No stray 'null' or dangling separators anywhere a firm is displayed (lists, profile, Home, branch plan, recorder, AI pickers)

Summary: Vendor code on DSA / connector + search by code
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Each DSA has a vendor code (VND-xxxxx), each connector CON-xxxxx; newly added ones show 'Vendor code pending'
- Code shown on Clients cards and on the profile header
- Clients and Plan your day search match the vendor code
Note: free-text tags were built and then removed on review — code only.

Summary: DSA summary: last 6 months business + NPA accounts
Description:
On the DSA profile Overview tab.

Acceptance criteria:
- 'Last 6 months' card: files, approved, amount disbursed, month-by-month disbursal chart; tap opens Business tab
- 'NPA accounts' card: count and % of book, total outstanding, each account with borrower, loan ID, product, NPA-since date, outstanding and DPD (worst first)
- DSAs with no NPA show 'None · 0%'
- Month labels always show the last 6 months up to today

Summary: OTC / PDD tab on DSA profile (pending documents from operations checklist)
Description:
New tab: Overview | Business | Files | OTC/PDD | Meetings | Notes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Document list per product comes from the operations checklist (stand-in for the admin-portal feed); each document is OTC (at signing/disbursal) or PDD (after) with a due period
- Summary: documents pending, files, overdue count; 'payout held' note when anything is overdue
- One card per file: each pending document with type, due date or days overdue; received documents expandable with dates; 'Payout on hold' on files with an overdue document
- 'Remind <DSA>' opens WhatsApp pre-filled with the pending list
- Read-only for the BO — only operations marks a document received

Summary: Marketing activity calendar plan
Description:
More > Marketing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Month calendar with a coloured dot per activity type, legend, tap a day to list its activities
- Plan an activity: type (Loan mela, Canopy/stall, Society/market camp, Trade association meet, Leaflet drive, DSA/connector meet, Branch event), optional title, date, start/end time, area, exact spot, field force picked from the branch team with employee codes
- Validation: past dates blocked, end after start, area and at least one person required
- Edit and delete own activities

Summary: Loan mela as a marketing activity type
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- 'Loan mela' is the first and default activity type
- Plan your day and More menu copy mention loan melas

Summary: Marketing activities in Plan your day
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Plan your day sheet has a 4th option: Marketing activity
- 'Visit DSAs & connectors' shows 'Marketing activities today' (assigned-to-me first); an activity can be added as a stop and appears on the map/route with its start time
- Once planned it shows on Home's next-stop card with a button to open the activity

Summary: Branch Head schedules marketing activity for BO
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Activities can come 'From Branch Head' (name + employee code) with a 'To accept' badge and a notification
- Marketing screen filter: All activities | From Branch Head (with count of new)
- Accept sheet: type, date, time, area and spot are locked; BO assigns field force and taps 'Accept & assign'; no delete
- Home shows a card in the 'Plan your day' style: '<Type> from <name>' + NEW / +N MORE; tap opens the accept sheet (or the filtered list)

Summary: Run a marketing activity: start/end time, photos, geo-tag monitoring, leads
Description:
Tap any activity to open its activity screen.

Acceptance criteria:
- Start activity (only on the activity's date) records actual time + GPS; live timer while running; End records time + GPS and shows started/ended/time on site
- Location checks: start, each photo and end measured against the planned area; more than 3 km flagged red
- Photos from the camera, each stamped with time and coordinates; allowed while running and after it ends
- Add lead: name, 10-digit mobile (validated), business, product, amount, note
- Past activities from before tracking show 'Not tracked'

Summary: Tag co-worker by employee code
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Reusable picker: type employee code or name, choose from suggestions; wrong code shows an error; own code refused
- Available on Log visit ('Co-workers on this visit') and on Add lead ('Tag a co-worker to follow up')
- Tagged people shown on the lead row and on the visit in the DSA's Meetings tab

Summary: Lead verification via one-tap link (customisable message)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Each lead has Verify; sheet shows the message to +91 number, editable
- Default message filled per lead (name, officer, branch, product, link); 'Use this wording for future leads' saves it as the template
- Send opens SMS pre-filled and marks the lead 'Link sent' (button becomes Resend)
- Borrower tap marks the lead 'Verified' (demo: 'Simulate tap')
Production follow-up: SMS gateway + backend endpoint for the link.

Summary: Plan on the go (add stop, skip/move, no plan required)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- '+ Add stop' on Route and Home: search DSAs, connectors, customers and today's marketing; add as Next stop or Later today without rebuilding the plan; route updates
- Each upcoming stop: Move to tomorrow, or Skip today with a reason; skipped stops leave the map and the day's target
- Visits added during the day are labelled 'On the go' (never 'unplanned'); Home shows '+N added on the go'
- 'Plan your day' card steps aside once the BO has logged or added a stop; Route empty state offers 'Just add a stop'

Summary: Bug: logging a planned visit left the stop as upcoming
Description:
Logging a visit for a stop already planned today created a second visit and left the planned one 'upcoming', so Home kept showing it as next.
Fix: logging completes the matching planned stop; only a visit with no matching stop is a new ('On the go') visit.

Summary: Bug: DSA charts showed fixed Apr–Sep month labels
Description: Month labels on DSA charts were hard-coded. Fix: labels are the last 6 months ending with the current month.

Summary: Offline single-file build that opens by double-clicking index.html
Description: npm run build:file produces dist-file/index.html with all JS/CSS inlined and hash routing, so it runs from the file system without a server. Share the whole dist-file folder (voice clips live next to it). Live AI is unavailable in this mode; Sarthi runs scripted.

Summary: Payout tracking (due and paid)
Description: Dropped for this round. Idea: payouts due vs paid per DSA/connector, with 'On hold' for files that have overdue OTC/PDD documents.

Summary: WhatsApp lead journey
Description: Dropped for this round. Idea: a sequence of ready-made WhatsApp follow-ups per lead (intro, document checklist, EMI estimate, reminder) with progress per lead.

Summary: Incentive on disbursement / EMI collected
Description: Dropped for this round.

Summary: Accelerated incentive above target (100–120%)
Description: Dropped for this round. Open point if picked up: higher rate between 100–120% of target, or extra only above 120%.

Summary: Earnings-goal plugin (set target income, see what it takes)
Description: Dropped for this round. Idea: BO sets a target income; app breaks it into files/disbursal/visits needed and tracks progress; switchable add-on.

Summary: Gamify the incentive section
Description:
Decide scope from the ideas list. Suggested first cut:
- Pick-your-goal target with live steps
- Daily quests with XP and a visit streak
- Quality multiplier (no NPA / no overdue OTC-PDD) so volume is never rewarded over quality
Delivered as an add-on section on the Incentive screen with an on/off toggle in Profile.

Summary: Clarify: OTC/PDD position in the file lifecycle
Description: Lead's flow puts OTC/PDD before fund transfer; PDD normally means documents collected after disbursal. Confirm the order (one-line change in the stage config).

Summary: Clarify: distance threshold for geo-tag check-ins
Description: Marketing check-ins more than 3 km from the planned area are flagged. Confirm the right distance with the lead.
